- **Closes:** AC-R-2.8.1-4 · AC-R-2.8.2-6 · AC-R-2.8.3-7 · AC-R-2.8.4-{12,13} · AC-R-2.8.6-{8,10} · AC-R-2.1.5-6

## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

Surveyed before implementation; the seam map:

| AC leg | Found | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| stronger containment classes | `IsolationClass` closed sum already declares `UserSpaceKernel`/`MicroVm`/`External`; `Ep2Model::apply` refused them (`UnsupportedIsolationClass`); `Backend::External` → `ExternalBackendNotImplemented` | real `BackendClass::{user_space_kernel, microvm, external, transparent_redirect}` variants, the substrate-attestation gate, `for_policy(policy)` selection, `NetPlane` distinction |
| attestation evidence | `hh_provenance::Attestation` + `verify_attestation` | containment-side attestation record → attach evidence (`Attested` vs plain enforcement); missing attestation ⇒ typed refusal |
| per-phase layers | `ContainmentPolicy.layers` + `phase: Option<String>` shape (declared, ungated) | `set_phase` sealed-`policy_rule` layer application through `meet::effective()`; undeclared-phase + non-`policy_rule`-basis refusals |
| delegation attenuation | `requested_grants ⊆ parent`, ceiling `min`, tool-table subsetting | `context` field on `SubagentSpec`; `ContextIsolation::LabelBranch` on `spawn`/`SubagentSpec` |
| label branches / `branch` remedy | `hh-provenance` remedy sum declares `branch`; `flow.rs::enumerate_remedies` | `spawn_branch`, `return_from_branch` exits (`abandon`/`labeled_return`/`attested_return`), `BranchTaintEscaped`/`ClearanceExceeded`/`BasisNotAllowed`/`BranchContextMissing`/`IllegitimateEndorsement`, remedy consumption |
| hosted children | `ChildProcess::Hosted(Ref<OpaqueProcess>)` variant; Hosting ABI `credential_supply` | `HostedPlane` trait seam + `SpawnCtx.hosted_plane`; hosted composition manifest (`participant_class = hosted`, `hosting_mechanism`, capability-declaration ref); uncovered-verb boundary refusal; pin/resolution checks |
| credentials | `wrapped_long_lived` isolation gate; `DestinationBinding.revocation_path` + `RevokeIntent` (S2.4); encoded-variant detectors + LT-12 miss-rate (S3.11b) | hosted `credential_supply` enforcement (declared channels only); LT-07 subagent/hosted scope tests |
| rotation e2e | `idp/1` profile + checkpoint layer (S2.5+) | `IDP_2` (SHA-512), profile-aware `idp_digest`/`parse_id`/`verify_id`, `RotationPlan`/`BridgeRecord`/`IdMigration`/`migrate_id`, `rotation`-kind checkpoint carrying `rehash` + `bridge_record_ref`, auditor rehash verify |
| bundle attestation | `traces{}` manifest member; checkpoint claims + proofs | `traces.audit_tree_head` written at export when a signed checkpoint exists; attestation predicate over checkpoint refs |
| lab-wide audit index | per-run auditor claims (`Auditor`, `Equivocation` detection) | `audit_index`: auditor-held durable rows — `run_id`/`checkpoint_ref`/`tree_size`/`tree_head`/`signatures`; conflicting heads surface `Equivocation` |
| hosted observability | `n/a{observability}` lowering on hosted rows | events-only observability renders ledger-internal components `n/a{observability}` in `audit_view` |

## Build log

- **hh-wire** (`src/sha512.rs`, new): NIST-known-answer SHA-512 for the
  `idp/2` profile.
- **hh-identity** (`src/idp.rs`, `src/rotation.rs` (new)): `IDP_2`
  registers under `sha512`; `idp_digest`/`parse_id`/`verify_id` are
  profile-parameterized (dispatch on the `algo:` prefix, never
  cross-profile); `RotationPlan` validates registered+distinct
  profiles and the `from_profile` binding; `BridgeRecord` seals and
  resolves (`Unbridged` typed); `IdMigration`/`migrate_id` rehash or
  alias-carry with `IdpNotWritable` on a retired target profile.
- **hh-ledger** (`src/rotation.rs` (new), `audit.rs`, `store.rs`,
  `tree.rs`, `classes.rs`, `schema.rs`): event/tree/checkpoint
  hashing parameterized by `IdentityProfile`; `rotation`-kind
  checkpoint carries the verified rehash (covered prefix re-digested
  under the target profile) + `bridge_record_ref` +
  `attestation_ref` + `prev` chain — a `rotation` claim through the
  plain `checkpoint` op refuses; `verify_run`/`verify` re-verify the
  rehash; `security.audit.bridge` class registered; `audit_view`
  under events-only observability renders ledger-internal components
  `n/a{observability}`; the lab-wide `audit_index` appends
  auditor-held head rows (`run_id`/`checkpoint_ref`/`tree_size`/
  `tree_head`/`signatures`) — writer-unforgeable — and conflicting
  heads surface `Equivocation`.
- **hh-containment** (`src/backend.rs`, `attach.rs`, `policy.rs`,
  `probes.rs`): `BackendClass::{UserSpaceKernel, Microvm, External,
  TransparentRedirect}` + `Namespaces`; `for_policy(policy)` is the
  single policy→backend selection; `NetPlane` distinguishes
  `BridgedChannel` from `TransparentRedirect` (no owned socket —
  probes skip the socket check); `Attestation` gate —
  `user_space_kernel`/`microvm` refuse without a resolving substrate
  attestation and emit `Attested` evidence only when one resolves;
  `external` reports `reported` never `probed`.
- **hh-env** (`src/driver.rs`): `set_phase` re-derives effective
  containment through `meet::effective()` over the live policy ⊓ the
  sealed `policy_rule` layer; undeclared phase ⇒ typed refusal;
  non-`policy_rule` basis ⇒ refusal; unentitled loosening ⇒
  `ContainmentWidening`.
- **hh-embed** (`src/open.rs`): the three hard-coded
  `Ep2Model::reference()` sites replaced by
  `hh_containment::backend::for_policy`; `environment_spec` surfaces
  optional substrate-attestation info; provisioning/attach/manifest
  evidence/bypass gating follow the policy-selected backend.
- **hh-subagent** (`src/branch.rs` (new), `src/hosted.rs` (new),
  `types.rs`, `spawn.rs`, `result.rs`, `lib.rs`):
  `ContextIsolation::LabelBranch`; `spawn_branch` —
  `control.subagent.spawned` carries `isolation`/`ctx0`/`clearance`;
  `return_from_branch` exits `abandon` (recorded, no re-entry),
  `labeled_return` (re-enter at `external` + union taint; a `declared`
  label dropping a required taint tag ⇒ `BranchTaintEscaped`),
  `attested_return` (capacity-bounded schema endorsement raises
  `external → environment`; free text ⇒ `BasisNotAllowed`;
  child-side endorsement ⇒ `IllegitimateEndorsement`); ceiling above
  clearance ⇒ `ClearanceExceeded`; `return_from_branch` on a
  non-branch child ⇒ `BranchContextMissing`; the `branch` remedy
  consumes by spawning a label branch. `HostedPlane` trait is the
  hosting seam: `spawn` composes `ChildProcess::Hosted` through the
  plane — manifest `participant_class = hosted` +
  `hosting_mechanism` + capability-declaration ref; hosted child
  without a plane ⇒ `ModeUnsupported`; unresolvable/unpinned hosted
  ref ⇒ definition error; a call outside the declared capability
  vector refuses at the boundary.
- **hh-orchestrator**: `SpawnCtx` construction sites gain
  `hosted_plane`/`branch_ctx` (native contexts pass `None`).
- **hh-bundle** (`src/export.rs`, `levels.rs`, `manifest.rs`):
  `traces.audit_tree_head` — the signed-checkpoint claim
  (`checkpoint_ref`, `tree_size`, `tree_head`, signatures) is written
  only when a signed checkpoint exists; absent ⇒ no claim (never a
  fabricated attestation).
- **hh-secrets / hh-hosting**: LT-12 encoded-variant detectors +
  seeded-corpus miss-rate confirmed landed from S3.11b (base64 std +
  url-safe, lower/upper hex, percent-encoding);
  `wrapped_long_lived` containment gate confirmed (≥
  `process_sandbox`, `EnvironmentNotIsolated` below); hosted
  `credential_supply` enforcement exercised — a hosted participant
  with no declared channels receives no binding, and delivery binds
  only declared channels; LT-07 subagent scope outside the parent's
  grant ⇒ `ScopeExceedsChannel`, and a delegate issuer never confers.
- **Tests:** `hh-subagent/tests/s4_14b.rs` (14),
  `hh-containment/tests/s4_14b.rs` (6), `hh-env/tests/s4_14b.rs` (5),
  `hh-ledger/tests/s4_14b_rotation.rs` (5), `hh-bundle/tests/
  s4_14b.rs` (2), `hh-hosting/tests/s4_14b.rs` (2),
  `hh-secrets/tests/s4_14b.rs` (1); plus `hh-identity` rotation unit
  tests.
- **ADR-0307** records the five rulings: backend spellings +
  `for_policy` selection; `attested` evidence semantics (never
  claimed without a resolving substrate attestation, `unknown` never
  coerced upward); the `rotation`-checkpoint record shape
  (rehash + bridge + attestation refs); hosted composition behind
  the `HostedPlane` trait seam (C-10 opacity — the kernel never
  resolves an `OpaqueProcess` itself); the label-branch exit set and
  the `branch`-remedy consumption rule.

## Notes / deviations

- **Hosted composition stays behind the `HostedPlane` trait seam**
  (ADR-0307 D4): `hh-subagent` never reads the Hosting
  implementation and never decomposes an `OpaqueProcess`; the seam
  supplies participant resolution, capability declaration,
  observability, and the child composition data. Uncovered verbs
  refuse at the boundary.
- **`context` is a new `SubagentSpec` member.** Test fixtures at
  `hh-subagent/tests/s4_6.rs`, `s4_8.rs`,
  `hh-orchestrator/tests/s4_6.rs`, `s4_8.rs` gained
  `context: ContextIsolation::Fresh` + `branch_ctx`/`hosted_plane`
  ctx members — mechanical field additions, no semantic change.
- **`BranchExit` is not `#[non_exhaustive]`-boxed** — the
  `large_enum_variant` allow records the call: the variants are the
  spec's closed record shapes and branch exits are low-frequency.
- **Deferrals** — DF-S1.12-5 and DF-S1.13-4 close (their named
  S4.14b cells are executable); DF-S1.11-2 and DF-S1.15-3 get dated
  progress notes (hosted-boundary refusals + rotation/audit-index
  cells landed; `check_write`-at-`prepare`, depth-3 chains, witness
  cosignatures/receiver receipts/per-event encryption remain with
  their owning tickets). No new rows opened.
